meaning:
στηριγμός, -οῦ, ὁ
(στηρίζω), [in Sm.: Isa.3:1 * ;]
1. a setting firmly, supporting.
2. fixedness, firmness, steadfastness: 2Pe.3:17.†
(AS)

elsewhere.note: You therefore, beloved, knowing these things beforehand, beware, lest being carried away with the error of the wicked, you fall from your own steadfastness.
